explanation: Job 1 corrupts the provenance handoff by writing each evidence_sources record_id from source_id, producing s01...s08 instead of the demand record identities n06-r01...n06-r08. Job 2 then cannot match evidence_sources.record_id to coverage.record_id, so every priority row has upstream_rank 0. The responsible function is supported by the captured assemble_provenance source.
cited_evidence: Job 1 output evidence_sources contains {'rank': 1, 'record_id': 's01', 'source_id': 's01'} while needs contains record_id 'n06-r01' with source_id 's01'.
prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources record_id and looks up coverage record_id; observed Job 2 priorities all show upstream_rank: 0.
